model.name: Method/Class detail panel shows NO code location — a user clicks a method and gets a bare, useless panel @390
model.description: USER-VISIBLE DEFECT (architect+expert prod sweep, served v0.8.150). A user clicks a Method or Class in /trace or /model and the detail panel opens BARE: the red 'Method' badge + the name + the uuid, but NO source-file link, NO description body, empty sections = nothing to act on. MEASURED (robbin-req reproduced architect exactly): 344/657 Method units (52%) + 60/192 Class units (31%) have no model.sourceFile. Root (expert): sourceFile absent -> renderSourceLink() returns '' in rb-method-detail (fetchDetailData -> /api/trace/children data.sourceFile). ★ DERIVABLE: 328 of the 344 methods HAVE an implementation that carries sourceFile (the FORWARD edge, R37.32) = the fix derives the link from impl.sourceFile.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On a 390px screen, opening a LIVE method's detail shows a '📄 <path>:<line>' source link — a screenshot shows the link present, matching an already-enriched method's panel. Today it is absent = the defect.

On 390px, a live method detail SHOWS the full signature line — visibility name(parameters):returnType — plus docs, per R36.3 AC-gate-390 (the authoritative AC). A screenshot shows the signature line present, matching an enriched method. Today it is absent (tester rendered @390: no signature/params/returnType/description) = the confirmed defect. NOTE: deriving sourceFile alone (the 📄 link) does NOT satisfy this — the signature must render too.
The detail shows a description body + populated sections, not just badge+name+uuid. Screenshot: the body is non-empty for a live method.

For the 328/344 methods whose implementation carries sourceFile, the link is DERIVED from impl.sourceFile (forward edge) and renders — a user never sees a bare panel for a method that has a shipped impl. Screenshot: such a method shows 📄 path:line.

The count of Method/Class detail panels that render with NO source link AND NO description trends toward 0 for units that have a derivable source; the remaining (genuinely source-less) are explicitly marked, not blank.

R40.71 is satisfied ONLY when ALL FOUR conditions render @390; the v0.8.151 ship delivered 1 of 4 = PARTIAL, NOT done. (1) METHOD source-link — DELIVERED (v0.8.151, derive sourceFile from impl, 328/344, screenshot-verified @390). (2) METHOD full-signature render — OPEN, SPLIT to R40.74 (distinct-kind; 0/657 carry signature data). (3) ~16 residual methods (344 minus 328 derivable) with no impl carrying sourceFile — OPEN, still bare; must be explicitly MARKED, not blank. (4) CLASS detail — OPEN, 78 classes render no source link on served tree (PO-ruled: 60 absent + 18 mis-populated=R40.75); class source-link BUILT-AND-HELD (v0.8.152 committed NOT served); signature=R40.74; 18-data=R40.75. A board that reads the v0.8.151 ship as done is WRONG: 3 of 4 remain. Screenshot each condition @390.
